nodes.name: Autumn.java
nodes.summary: Static convenience facade for the Autumn parsing library providing overloaded parse methods for parsers, rules, and grammars with configurable ParseOptions, delegating to Parse.run.

nodes.name: MalformedGrammarError.java
nodes.summary: Exception class for malformed grammar errors, carrying a reference to the WellFormednessChecker that detected the issue.

nodes.name: ParseMetrics.java
nodes.summary: Container for per-parser timing metrics with a toString method that formats a sorted breakdown of self-time and total-time for each parser.

nodes.name: ParseOptions.java
nodes.summary: Immutable configuration value class for parsing with trace, recordCallStack, wellFormednessCheck, trackWhitespace, metrics, and customOptions, plus a fluent builder via ParseOptionsBuilder.

nodes.name: Benchmark.java
nodes.summary: Benchmark runner for Java parsing performance that iterates over a corpus of Java files, measuring parse time with configurable tracing and metrics, then logging results.

nodes.name: JSON.java
nodes.summary: Autumn grammar definition for JSON parsing, specifying lexer rules (numbers, strings, punctuation) and parser rules (value, pair, object, array) with a root rule and main method.

nodes.name: Runner.java
nodes.summary: Orchestrator for the Rust language implementation that parses input, creates semantic analysis walker, runs interpreter, and handles errors with formatted output.

nodes.name: AttributeTreeFormatter.java
nodes.summary: Formats a Uranium attribute tree as indented text using a walker with preVisit/postVisit callbacks, displaying attribute values for each node.

nodes.name: SemanticError.java
nodes.summary: Semantic error with description, optional cause (chained error with location), and formatted toString output for error reporting.

nodes.name: NFiles.java
nodes.summary: File utility providing glob-based file discovery walking a directory tree, with a dotfile filter predicate.

nodes.name: GenericType.java
nodes.summary: Wrapper around ParameterizedType providing access to raw type, actual type arguments, and owner type, with a static wrap factory method.

nodes.name: Subtyping.java
nodes.summary: Comprehensive subtype checking utility with 36 overloaded check methods handling ParameterizedType, TypeVariable, WildcardType, GenericArrayType, and raw Class types with full generic type argument resolution.

nodes.name: ReflectiveAccessorWalker.java
nodes.summary: Reflective walker that discovers child nodes via getter methods matching a return type, using reflection and subtype checking.

nodes.name: ReflectiveFieldWalker.java
nodes.summary: Reflective walker that discovers child nodes via public fields matching a type, using reflection and subtype checking.

nodes.name: WalkVisitType.java
nodes.summary: Enum defining walk visit types (PRE_VISIT, POST_VISIT) for the visitor framework controlling traversal order.

nodes.name: WellFormednesTest.java
nodes.summary: Test class verifying grammar well-formedness checks in Autumn, testing left recursion, anonymous left recursion, empty string repetition, optional repetition, and nullable repetition detection.
